arguments.summary: Fixed `store/cache.py` — the `get` method now checks the entry's timestamp against the TTL. If the entry is expired (`now - timestamp > ttl`), the file is removed from disk and the default value is returned. Also cleaned up stale files `old_1.json` and `old_2.json` from the `cache/` directory (they had timestamp 0, clearly expired). The `keep.json` file (with a very large timestamp) was kept as it is still fresh. Both unit tests pass.
